svg.title: Worm axes are offset; bevel axes intersect
svg.desc: Two right-angle drives. The worm axis passes above the wheel axle, which points out of the page. Equal bevel gears have slanted teeth on two 45-degree pitch cones with a shared virtual apex. Their extended shaft centerlines cross at that point. The bevel teeth are phased by half a tooth pitch.

g.text: Both turn a corner. Only one pair has crossing axes.
Follow each shaft’s centerline, not the outside of the gear.
wheel axis points out of the page
teeth cut on a slanted face
the two axes meet at one point
A screw drives a toothed wheel.
The pitch cones share this apex.
